name: aqara.contact.mccgq11lm
note: Aqara door and window sensor. Paired and read on the real device (24 October 2026, Zigbee2MQTT 2.14.2): contact is false when the door opens, true when it closes. Pairing: hold the button 5 s, then press it briefly every 2 to 3 s during the interview (about 30 s). battery and linkquality: names from the Zigbee2MQTT documentation.
